character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A Korean man in his late twenties who works part-time at a small village shop while preparing for job applications. He has neatly trimmed straight black hair with a simple side part, calm eyes, and a polite but emotionally restrained expression. His posture is straight and formal, but he looks slightly tired.

He wears a clean off-white collared shirt, a muted navy sleeveless sweater vest, dark gray trousers, and simple black shoes. Slim average build with slightly narrow shoulders, a slightly large head, and a clear tidy silhouette.

Cozy Korean countryside mystery game character, muted natural colors, simple low-detail pixel art, restrained two-step shading, subtle dark-brown selective outlines, low top-down camera view.

No hat, no glasses, no tie, no weapon, no papers, no item in hands, no modern accessories, no text, plain transparent background.
